title: Onset-Matched Alpha Spending
strategies: trivial: non-adaptive 2-look plan (5%/95% Bonferroni-safe alpha split, no futility, no onset-awareness) -- reproduces the checker's own baseline B -> ~0.1

greedy: textbook Pocock group-sequential plan -- K_max equally-spaced looks from patient 1, one calibrated flat threshold, no futility, onset_frac ignored; on delayed-onset instances its early looks carry no power so overall power falls below the required floor -> scores 0 there

strong: onset-matched design -- concentrate all looks in [onset_frac*N_max, N_max], an O'Brien-Fleming-cubic spending schedule calibrated on that window, plus a mild futility boundary that harvests extra savings on null cohorts for free; stays feasible and keeps saving cost even when greedy collapses
invalid: repeated testing at the unadjusted nominal threshold at every look -- best nominal power, but the true family-wise type-I error blows the cap on every instance -> 0
